title: Chapter 184 Successfully Survives The Catastrophe
content:
Chapter 184 Successfully Survives The Catastrophe

Accompanied by the complete collapse of the entire void.

The sound of the bell slowly dissipated.

The calamity cloud that frightened countless people in the world finally gradually disappeared in the sky.

It's over.

But, is the Queen of the Divine Dynasty still alive?

Everyone stared blankly at the void with hope in their eyes.

Once Yan Lingyun got into trouble, they dared not imagine how angry the Lord of the City would be.

At this time, a figure suddenly appeared in the void.

Lu Daosheng looked in the direction in front of him and was relieved.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

Countless pure energy suddenly condensed towards the front.

"Daosheng..."

At this time, a somewhat weak voice sounded in front of Lu Daosheng.

The smoke dissipated.

Yan Lingyun's somewhat illusory figure appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Looking at Yan Lingyun at this time, Lu Daosheng felt very distressed.

Facing seven heavenly tribulations, Yan Lingyun survived.

With the help of Lu Daosheng, Yan Lingyun's body began to recover rapidly.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng suddenly looked condensed.

I saw a faint light flashing in the depths of Yan Lingyun's body.

"What is that?"

Lu Daosheng looked a little confused.

But at this moment, Yan Lingyun was still in the state of recovery, and Lu Daosheng did not want to disturb Yan Lingyun.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng waved his hand to lay a barrier, and then returned to the Lord's Mansion of the Deserted City.

"Dad, is my mother okay?"

Seeing Lu Daosheng's expression, Lu Xue already had the answer in her heart, but still asked.

"Your mother is fine."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was relieved.

At this time, Lu Daosheng continued: "Xiaoxue, you stay here to help Dad keep an eye on it, Dad is going to do something."

After that, Lu Daosheng disappeared directly on the spot.

Above the sky.

A place where no one can set foot.

A shadow was standing quietly there.

Buzz——

The space cracked, and Lu Daosheng stepped out slowly.

"You, better give me an explanation."

An extremely cold voice came from Lu Daosheng's mouth.

The next moment, a terrifying pressure directly crushed the shadow in the distance.

In just a moment, the shadow's figure began to become illusory.

"You, what do you want to do?"

The shadow is the will of this world.

The embodiment of order and rules, Tiandao!

At this moment, facing Lu Daosheng, Tiandao showed a look of fear.

As Tiandao, he only cares about the existence that threatens the world.

Although Lu Daosheng often cannot control his power, he has never really harmed this world.

So Tiandao does not recognize Lu Daosheng.

Hearing Tiandao's words, Lu Daosheng sneered.

"What do I want to do? Don't you know what you did to my wife?"

After hearing this, Tiandao finally understood a little.

That woman has a close relationship with the man in front of him.

"Why, you don't want to talk anymore?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the silent Tiandao in front of him and clenched his fists slowly.

Seeing this scene, Tiandao trembled slightly, "You, you can't be so unreasonable."

"Unreasonable?"

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

Tiandao nodded, "It's because that woman threatens this world, so it's like this."

After hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned even more deeply.

The next moment, a destructive breath rushed out of Lu Daosheng's body.

In an instant, the entire space began to collapse inch by inch.

"Then take a look, have I threatened this world?"

The threatening breath was beyond words.

This time, Tiandao was completely silent.

At the same time, above the void of the deserted city.

Boom!

A breath that does not belong to this world rose from the void and broke through the sky!

I saw Yan Lingyun's figure slowly emerging.

"It's your majesty!"

In the deserted city, the strong men of the Divine Dynasty were suddenly very excited.

Seeing that Yan Lingyun was safe and sound, didn't it mean that the tribulation was successful?

Sure enough, in the void, Yan Lingyun's breath suddenly began to surge wildly.

Countless space cracks gradually condensed around Yan Lingyun.

That was because this world could no longer accommodate Yan Lingyun's rhythm.

Buzz——

At this moment, Yan Lingyun's body suddenly began to become illusory.

The next moment, countless majestic pure energy began to continuously flow into Yan Lingyun's body.

Suddenly, Yan Lingyun's breath began to change again.

If the surge in breath just now was a quantitative change.

Then this time, it was a qualitative change.

This is the feedback from the world after the tribulation.

"Hmm?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun suddenly frowned slightly.

"Why so many?"

It shouldn't be.

Could it be that this world has recognized me?

What a joke, I am a rule breaker.

This situation can only happen if this world gives in.

But it doesn't make sense.

After a moment of silence, Yan Lingyun shook her head slightly. No matter how many, it's useless.

After an unknown amount of time, Yan Lingyun's breath finally stabilized.

She breathed a sigh of relief.

The whole void began to hum.

She is too strong now.

Of course, only for this world.

At the same time, above the sky, where only Yan Lingyun could see, an illusory fairy gate slowly emerged.

Looking at the immortal gate, Yan Lingyun's eyes were calm.

Finally, I was going back to the immortal world.

"Lingyun."

Just when Yan Lingyun was lost in thought, Lu Daosheng's figure appeared not far away.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun turned her head and looked.

I saw Lu Daosheng walking slowly towards here.

And beside him, there was a guy who surprised Yan Lingyun.

"Tian Dao?"

Yan Lingyun frowned and stared at Tian Dao beside Lu Daosheng with a somewhat unfriendly look.

After all, she had just been treated so badly by Tian Dao.

Although Tian Dao gave her benefits again.

But Yan Lingyun would not let it go.

"Do you have any opinion about me?"

Looking at Tian Dao, Yan Lingyun said in a bad tone.

Hearing this, Tian Dao stared at Yan Lingyun and said in a light voice: "I don't have any opinion about you, it's that there is something dirty in your body."

Hearing this, a burst of anger suddenly erupted from Yan Lingyun's heart.

"What do you mean?!"

Tian Dao took two steps back and looked at Lu Daosheng with some fear.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng stepped forward and grabbed Yan Lingyun's hand.

"Lingyun, calm down."

"What this guy said is true. There is indeed something in your body that threatens this world, so the heavenly tribulation will explode with unprecedented power."

Lu Daosheng's words seemed to have magic power, and immediately calmed Yan Lingyun down.

"In my body?"

Yan Lingyun slowly closed her eyes, and the next moment, a bead emitting a strange aura slowly emerged from Yan Lingyun's abdomen.

Seeing this thing, Tian Dao immediately retreated again and again, and his expression gradually became terrified.

And on the side, Lu Daosheng also narrowed his eyes slightly.

"Chaos Pearl?"

"No!"

Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand, and the bead immediately floated into Lu Daosheng's hand.

Feeling the wanton energy in the bead, Lu Daosheng looked solemn.
